name: Agent Plan
goal: Deliver a self-hosted Claude Code plugin (marketplace, no approval) bundling @agent-plan/mcp + a /planner skill + a non-blocking SessionStart hook, with a reusable multi-plugin folder structure ready for Codex and future harnesses.
description: Self-improvement: add harness-specific plugin bundles (Claude Code first, Codex next) alongside the existing npm packages, so Agent Plan integrates natively with multiple coding-agent harnesses.

projectGuidelines.content:
- use the available react skill. 
- make each component small and reusable. fully typescript typed and expandable. 
- add unit tests to every component
- make the UI user friendly
- use the best react-router 7 patterns: form submissions, navigation and middleware

acceptedDecisions.title: The no-task guard never blocks or asks; it only warns the agent
acceptedDecisions.decision: Every tool call is allowed whether or not a task is in progress. When a call changes project code (inside the project, outside .planner/) and no task is in progress, the agent receives a warning and nothing else: no permission prompt, no denial. Planner operations (CRUD on project, features, phases, tasks, requirements, decisions, handoffs, and writes under .planner/) never require an in-progress task and never produce the warning. Writes outside the project (/dev/null, ~/.claude, temp dirs, other repos) produce nothing.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: User decision 2026-09-28: "MUST be allowed for every command except the codebase just a warning is showed to the agent. NO BLOCKING things." Guessing writes from shell text misfires, and a prompt interrupts the user for a false positive; a warning to the agent costs nothing when wrong.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Rule lives once in packages/plan-core/src/guard-decision.ts (classifyGuardedTool decides what is project code; the guard returns only an optional warning text). Adapters only deliver the warning: Claude Code hook via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext with no permissionDecision; Pi via its tool_call handler. The bypass window silences the warning.

acceptedDecisions.title: Parked tasks are re-checked, never silently skipped
acceptedDecisions.decision: Task recommendation and the load recap list on-hold tasks (deferred, waiting, blocked) in phases already under way, plus the phase being recommended, each with the reason it was parked. When a reason names planner refs (P097, P097(F003), F003/P097, P094(F011)/T449, T468) and every named phase or task is finished, the task is flagged "may be ready" and becomes a recommendation claim. Free-text reasons are shown but never flagged. The list is bounded and never blocks or changes a task's status.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: heca 2026-09-28: after P082's planned work finished, the recommendation jumped to an unstarted phase while four parked tasks whose blocker (P097) had finished stayed hidden; the user had to notice. A reason is prose, so a match is a hint for the agent to re-check, not an automatic resume.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: One module, packages/plan-core/src/on-hold.ts (listOnHoldWork, refsNamedIn, startedOpenPhaseIds, renderOnHoldWork). recommendNextWork adds `onHold` and "on-hold" claims ahead of other advisories; buildRecommendationReply and buildRecap render the same block, so MCP, Pi and the server agree. Refs resolve by number only, never by title; a ref naming nothing in the plan, or the task itself, is not treated as finished.
